name: Kenya Pipeline Company Plc
source: Kenya Pipeline Company IPO Information Memorandum (2026), Selected Financial Data, from the Reporting Accountant's Report (consolidated, audited & restated) | CRON 20261014B: FY2026 (year ended 30 June 2026) column read from Kenya Pipeline Company Plc consolidated audited financial results FY 2025/26, condensed consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, group column (KShs thousands read as absolute KES): Total revenue 42,978,067; Direct costs 9,164,051; Gross margin 33,814,016; Operating expenses 8,861,258; EBITDA 24,952,758; depreciation and amortisation 7,744,716; EBIT 17,208,042; Net interest income 327,362; Profit before tax 17,535,404; income tax expense 5,953,477; Profit for the year 11,581,927; Earnings per share 0.64 as printed. Gates tie on the printed lines: total revenue less direct costs equals 33,814,016, less operating expenses equals 24,952,758, less depreciation and amortisation equals 17,208,042, plus net interest income equals 17,535,404, less income tax equals 11,581,927. PRESENTATION CAVEAT: this audited summary presents direct costs separately from operating expenses and depreciation, so the FY2026 Cost of Services and Gross Profit and Operating Expenses rows are on a narrower cost definition than the stored FY2021 to FY2025 columns and the gross margin is not directly comparable across the column break. The summary also restates the prior year comparatives: it prints FY2025 total revenue 39,502,167, EBIT 16,107,509, profit before tax 16,170,572 and profit for the year 10,241,466, while the stored FY2025 column carries 38,593,631 revenue, 11,931,026 EBIT, 12,018,372 profit before tax and 7,491,208 profit, so the stored FY2021 to FY2025 columns follow the superseded presentation and need re-collection from the FY2025 statements before the series is comparable. EPS is stored on the printed per share basis, 0.64; the previously stored FY2021 to FY2025 EPS values were 1,000,000 times the per share figure and have been rescaled in this change, verified against the identity profit divided by EPS giving a constant share count of about 18.1 billion in every year.
source_note: KShs'000 x1000 to absolute KES. Year-end 30 June. FY2024-FY2025 are consolidated group (post-KPRL acquisition Oct 2023); FY2021-FY2023 are company-only.
